gerp_profile_id.description: hash key; the public polymorphic identity. person = the account's Cognito sub; business = the gerp_id. the public identity itself — what a `subject` elsewhere resolves THROUGH

kind.description: which profile bucket applies; a person edges an account_id, a business edges a gerp_id

edges.description: the underlying id this profile fronts: account_id (person) or gerp_id (business)

display_name.description: shown to readers; person = first+last, business = label. Derived on write, never user-supplied

city.description: coarse location match dimension ("techs in this city")

lat.description: geocoded latitude; the proximity/radius constraint that refines a location match

email.description: the reachable channel a match needs to become a conversation

verified.description: identity/credential verification; owned by the future verification flow, never written on an owner save

type.description: link kind, e.g. website | linkedin | instagram

soc.description: what this person has done — their HISTORY, measured from their work across openly-operated gerps: a hours-weighted distribution over O*NET-SOC occupations read off the tasks they closed. Written by the platform's count, never by the owner. Hierarchical: index/query by code prefix ("35-3023" finds "35-3023.01")

share.description: this occupation's share of the hours in the window, 0..1

hours.description: hours logged against tasks of this occupation in the window

soc_intended.description: what this person says they do — O*NET-SOC codes picked from the list, labeled as intended. The history twin is `soc`, measured from their work. Hierarchical: index/query by code prefix

soc_window.description: the window the measurement covers, as "<from>..<to>" dates; absent until a count has run

label.description: business name; display_name derives from it for business rows

naics.description: what this business has done — its HISTORY, measured from what it sells: a revenue-weighted distribution over NAICS industries read off its paid invoice lines. Written by the platform's count, never by the owner. Hierarchical: index/query by code prefix. Crosswalks to SOC for person↔business matches

share.description: this industry's share of the revenue in the window, 0..1

revenue.description: revenue on lines of this industry in the window

naics_intended.description: what this business says it does — NAICS codes picked from the list, labeled as intended; how a gerp that has not sold anything yet is found. The history twin is `naics`, measured from its sales. Hierarchical: index/query by code prefix

naics_window.description: the window the measurement covers, as "<from>..<to>" dates; absent until a count has run
